title: Construct the whole native odd-E8 K core and a cross-cube primitive (no new κ)
body:
The odd-E8 construction in #5439 supplies scalar geometry but leaves the native producer incomplete. This PR implements two concrete native components: **the entire block-diagonal K core, with normalized forward and backward programs**, and the previously submitted **one directed cross-cube H_ab transfer**. It does not construct all H, close a complete supplier or claim a new κ.

### Whole native K core

The new `research/odd-e8-whole-k-native` package starts with arbitrary independent physical ground-chart inputs. For Q=C0, D=C[1,25), and the explicitly emitted real normalizers L_i, its exact contracts are

```
F_K = diag(D,D) L(C_K Q^-1)
B_K = diag(D,D) U(-Q C_K)
C_K = diag(L_i^-1) K_odd diag(L_i)
```

C_K is a symmetric involution commuting with R=DQ. No commutation with Q is assumed. The reader endpoint is coupled; it receives no autonomous Gaussian target credit. The source virtual-Q input and reader exit are actual ordinary monomial wrappers, including absolute phase. No incoming Gaussian service is assumed free.

Every 512-port cube uses two mutually orthogonal nine-spaces, direct same-frame ADDs, and **no helper, owned field, COPY or CLEAR**. These nine-spaces have pairing rank one and radical dimension eight; they are not orthonormal I9 spaces. The complete per-port bill is:

| Word | Paid children | ADD | P | D | X | phase |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| F_K | H8 + H9 + H15 + H16 | 76 | 15 | 15 | 6 | 6 |
| B_K | H8 + H9 + H15 + H16 | 76 | 15 | 15 | 13 | 6 |

The backward program is emitted gate by gate by inverse transpose in the same chronological order, with all boundary maps. Each inverse child is an actual positive Gaussian plus X. The construction never inverts an erasure.

The structured constructor covers all 2,744 disjoint cubes: 1,404,928 ports, two original fields per port, one child of each paid rank per port, and 106,774,528 ADDs. The root cube is fully emitted. All-family geometry is checked independently; generic Lagrangian and absolute-phase proofs cover every constructor instance. A second distinct cube `(13,7,2)` was also fully compiled and independently replayed. This is not a claim that every all-family phase instance was executed.

- [Physical construction and arbitrary-width proof](https://github.com/thu-nmrc/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3981f9539e63630681f6903e3c6a50b3a0d2f2dd/research/odd-e8-whole-k-native/PROOF.md)
- [Actual forward contract and invoice](https://github.com/thu-nmrc/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3981f9539e63630681f6903e3c6a50b3a0d2f2dd/research/odd-e8-whole-k-native/K-MODULE.json)
- [Literal backward construction](https://github.com/thu-nmrc/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3981f9539e63630681f6903e3c6a50b3a0d2f2dd/research/odd-e8-whole-k-native/BACKWARD-PROOF.md)
- [Separate AI-worker scientific review](https://github.com/thu-nmrc/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3981f9539e63630681f6903e3c6a50b3a0d2f2dd/research/odd-e8-whole-k-native/REVIEW.md)

The independent checker reconstructs all 262,144 root-cube K entries, replays all 1,024 logical input columns, and checks every actual chart and literal invoice. It separately compares all 43,008 forward instructions with the emitted backward inverse-transpose stream and its 1,536 boundaries. Executed controls reject a changed coefficient, source overwrite, wrong chart and a phase-only error. Generic phase proofs are corroborated by exhaustive small-dimensional cases, rather than inferred from width-one matrix sums. At field width f, owner coefficients are applied once and literal phases lift as i^(f theta). Local field-norm growth is bounded; complete precision and machine costs remain caller obligations.

### Retained directed cross-cube component

`research/odd-e8-polarized-native` is unchanged from commit c9875dccd281e6fe7d9b28a38f6c385141df0950. Its exact interface remains

```
source: Phi_[q_s] x_s -> R25 x_s
reader: y_r -> Phi_(q_r^perp)(y_r + sum_s H_ab[r,s] x_s)
owned C0: zero@ground -> zero@ground
paid: {7:512, 8:512, 16:512, 17:512}
```

That component's incoming line services must still be paid by its eventual caller. Its polarized 64-channel factorization uses four actual eight-space pairs, 13,056 ADDs and one returned zero-owned scratch. The retained package includes independent emitted-word review and the restricted geometry's minimal I20 embedding proof; its native word remains 25D. Neither the K core nor the directed H_ab block supplies the missing reciprocal/full-H chronology automatically.

### Validation and remaining gate

Both packages register eight bounded commands on CPython 3.12 with only the standard library:

```
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/odd-e8-whole-k-native
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/odd-e8-whole-k-native
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/odd-e8-polarized-native
```

The new package's eight registered commands, exact 27-file committed-byte check and official export validation pass. Its exact committed export also passes all eight commands with no Git, empty PATH and read-only source files, leaving every exported byte unchanged. The retained package's earlier eight-command cold replay remains applicable to its unchanged bytes. Regenerated scientific artifacts compare canonical decompressed JSON, not gzip container metadata. Hosted CI is separate execution evidence.

The decisive missing work is an actual compatible K/H/F3 chronological construction, including source acquisition, decoding, all original-input endpoints and a positive complete caller invoice. Precision, storage, movement and compiler costs remain necessary. Local K savings or optimistic scalar pairing tariffs do not establish that result. The selected conditional κ at canonical main 32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04 remains 0.003027288235. No scientific admission, independent human review, formal-kernel verification or practical speedup is claimed.

Pre-publication refresh retained that canonical main. Bounded overlap checked live odd-E8 PR search results, including #5439 and complementary native/compiler work in #5467; it is not an exhaustive historical or unpublished-work priority claim. This update adds a second scoped package, changes no shared tooling or selected record, and preserves the original package bytes.

Credit Ali Romman for #5439's odd-E8 geometry and scalar K; Dugongue/#4929 and Dillon Amburgey for the code and real normalizers; Cao Yifan for the P112 native lineage; Cinna Davis, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman and the retained native, Clifford, compiler and analytic contributors. Classical Clifford, polarization, transposition and tensor identities retain their status. Prepared for THU New Media Research Center (@thu-nmrc) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate geometry, physical-compiler and reviewer agents. Apache-2.0.
